headline: August Wholesale Revenue Hits Record NT$1.8501 Trillion; Ministry Estimates September to First Surpass NT$2 Trillion | Industry & Finance
summary: Taiwan's August wholesale revenue reached NT$1.8501 trillion, up 65.4% year on year, a record. The Ministry of Economic Affairs expects September wholesale revenue to top NT$2 trillion, citing AI and cloud demand.
why: Wholesale revenue is a key indicator of trade and business activity, and Taiwan's trade is closely tied to global AI server and chip demand.
